data.prompt:
You are analyzing a book cover to create a UNIFIED BACKGROUND STYLE SPECIFICATION that will be used across ALL 5 Amazon A+ marketing banners for this book.

Analyze the book cover image carefully and output a precise, reusable background specification including:

1. PRIMARY BACKGROUND COLOR: Exact hex code and name (e.g., "deep navy blue #1a2e40")
2. ACCENT COLOR: Exact hex code for highlights (e.g., "amber gold #d9a86a")
3. GRADIENT DIRECTION: How colors blend (e.g., "radial from center", "linear top-to-bottom")
4. SUBTLE PATTERN: Any texture or pattern overlay (e.g., "subtle golden light rays at 10% opacity", "faint geometric lines")
5. OVERALL MOOD: Premium/minimal/warm/corporate etc.
6. TEXT COLORS: Primary text color, secondary text color, accent text color with hex codes

Format your output as a clean specification block that can be directly referenced in image-generation prompts. Be extremely specific with hex codes and percentages. The background is always one colour, with accents or slightly visible designs recalling the cover theme, no gradient.

Output ONLY the background specification, nothing else.

data.prompt:
You are an expert Amazon A+ content designer. You will receive TWO images:
1. A BOOK COVER - analyze it to extract: title, author, subtitle, color palette, design style, genre, target audience, mood
2. An A+ REFERENCE LAYOUT - study its exact composition, text placement, visual elements, and structure

Your task: Generate ONE image-generation prompt for the A+1 HERO IMAGE that:
- Replicates the EXACT layout, composition, and structure from the reference image
- Adapts ALL text content to match THIS book's topic, title, and themes
- Matches the book cover's color palette (primary, secondary, accent colors)
- Uses the book's actual title, author name, and subject matter
- Writes all visible text in Italian

The HERO IMAGE should showcase the book prominently (left side, held in hands or displayed large), with the main headline and compelling description on the right. Include a badge/seal element. Premium dark background matching the book's palette.

In your prompt:
- Specify "professional Amazon A+ marketing banner, aspect ratio 16:9, 970x600 pixels"
- Describe the background precisely (colors, gradients, subtle patterns)
- Describe LEFT and RIGHT side composition separately
- Write the EXACT Italian marketing text that should appear (headlines, body copy, badges)
- Specify typography styles (bold, serif, italic, size hierarchy)
- Reference the book's actual title and author by name

Output ONLY the image generation prompt, nothing else. No explanations, no headers.

data.outputText:
Professional Amazon A+ marketing banner, aspect ratio 16:9, 970x600 pixels. The background features a solid base of Warm Sand Beige #E8C18D on the left, transitioning into a large, premium Midnight Navy #112B3C section on the right. The entire background has a faint radial sunburst texture with thin, distressed light rays at 10% opacity emanating from the center.

On the LEFT side, a pair of realistic hands holds the physical book "PERSUASIONE ISTANTANEA IN 21 GIORNI" by Matt Rawling. The book cover is clearly displayed, showing the bold navy and beige design. In the top-left corner, there is a circular gold seal badge with the text "INCLUSO BONUS & E-BOOK".

On the RIGHT side, positioned over the Midnight Navy background, the text is arranged in a clean hierarchy:
- Top: "METODO SCIENTIFICO" in bold Muted Gold #C9A66B sans-serif.
- Main Headline: "PERSUASIONE: DOMINA LA TUA COMUNICAZIONE!" in large, impactful Pure White #FFFFFF bold sans-serif.
- Sub-headline: "Vuoi influenzare e persuadere con successo?" in Muted Gold #C9A66B medium-weight sans-serif.
- Body Paragraph: "È il momento di svoltare. Questo libro è il tuo alleato per padroneggiare le neuroscienze, eliminare l'insicurezza e prendere il controllo delle tue interazioni. Con strategie testate e tecniche scientifiche immediate, scoprirai come sviluppare carisma e creare una mentalità vincente." in clean Pure White #FFFFFF sans-serif.

In the top-right corner, a small red ribbon with "1st" is visible. The overall mood is authoritative, premium, and psychological, matching the book's theme of communication and neuroscience. Professional studio lighting, high resolution, sharp focus on typography.
